title: 第1章 健美圈传来噩耗VS独断腕骨季天帝第2章 战斗爽
slug: 我在西幻世界独断万古
content_zh:
【本书出现人物均已成年，没有的也会——1+（所以看到112岁不要惊讶）——，被肘飞过一次，已有小黑屋史，只能改了qaq?】
————————分割线
一场国际健美邀请赛。
米国队出场时，全场倒吸了一口凉气。
那名选手叫阿诺德·麦克·孙，是职业赛场上赫赫有名的“肉身坦克”。
胸大肌厚的能挡小口径手枪弹，双臂充血状态围度六十七公分。
据传这家伙从十八岁开始上科技，至今已循环过十七个周期，打印出来的药物清单比《大而美法案》的目录还长。
解说员激情澎湃：“这位是米国健美界的传奇人物，拥有很强的药物耐受能力，堪称......”
“耐药圣体！！”
角落里有个声音接了话。
众人回头，只见个瘦削的年轻人靠在墙边。他手里捏着瓶矿泉水，正用一种看宝贝的眼神盯着阿诺德。
他叫季天，中国队选手，据说是个来兼职的，据说从来没打过药，据说……
据说这哥们儿网文看多了，脑子有点毛病。
季天喃喃自语，眼神狂热，“耐药圣体啊，四品丹药耐药体质，日后若是寻得造化，未必不能蜕变为九品渡劫圣体……”
旁边的领队脸都绿了，小声提醒：“季天，别念了，那是人家外国选手，你念人家听不懂的干嘛？”
季天一脸认真，“我是在跟他论道。天下功法殊途同归，药道也是道。这位道友能以凡人之躯承载如此多的外丹之力，定有不凡之处。我想问问他是怎么炼的。”
阿诺德也看见了他，轻蔑的用蹩脚中文道：“小瘪三，尼，就是那个自然健身的中国人？？”
季天点点头，有问题想问对方，倒也没在意对方的无礼。
阿诺德拍了拍自己的胸肌，“窝卧推二百六十公斤！尼，夺少？”
季天伸出一根手指。

“一百？”
摇头。
“一千？”
还是摇头。
“尼到底夺少？”
负手而立，季天把矿泉水放在地上。他目光悠远，仿佛在看穿时空长河。
“我在睡梦中神游太虚时，曾见过一位元婴老祖一掌拍碎一座山。”
领队：“……”
阿诺德：“……”
“所以我觉得，用公斤来衡量力量，格局小了，力量这东西，讲的是道行，是心境，是对天地的感悟。你推二百六，你是推起来了，但你‘懂’了吗？你感受到肌肉纤维撕裂时那一缕大道至简的玄妙了吗？”
阿诺德脸都绿了。
比赛开始。
阿诺德先上。
他青筋暴起如蟒蛇盘踞，眼眶充血如走火入魔。
二百六十公斤，一气呵成！
全场掌声雷动。
“到尼了，小瘪三！”
季天走到卧推架前。没有热身，没有吼叫，只是深深吸了一口气。
然后闭上了眼睛。
旁边的人听见他在沉声念：“……天地玄宗，万炁本根。广修浩劫，证吾神通……”
content_en:
[The characters in this book are all adults, and those who are not will also be - 1+ (so don't be surprised to see 112 years old) -, was elbowed once, and has a history of being in a dark room, so it can only be changed to qaq?]
————————Dividing line
An international bodybuilding invitational competition.
When the American team came out, the audience gasped.
That player's name is Arnold Mike Sun, a well-known "flesh tank" in the professional arena.
The pectoralis major muscles are thick enough to block small-caliber pistol bullets, and the circumference of both arms is 67 centimeters in a congested state.
It is said that this guy started using technology at the age of eighteen and has gone through seventeen cycles so far. The list of printed drugs is longer than the list of the "Big and Beautiful Act".
The commentator was passionate: "This is a legend in the American bodybuilding industry. He has a strong drug tolerance and can be called..."
"Resistant Holy Body!!"
A voice from the corner answered.
Everyone turned around and saw a thin young man leaning against the wall. He held a bottle of mineral water in his hand and was staring at Arnold with a treasured look.
His name is Ji Tian, a Chinese team player. It is said that he works part-time. It is said that he has never taken any medicine. It is said that...
It is said that this guy has read too much online articles and has something wrong with his brain.
Ji Tian murmured to himself, with feverish eyes, "Resistant Holy Body, with a fourth-grade elixir-resistant constitution, if you find good luck in the future, you may not be able to transform into a ninth-grade Tribulation-Ending Holy Body..."
The team leader next to him turned green and reminded him in a low voice: "Ji Tian, stop reading, those are foreign players, why are you reading something they don't understand?"
Ji Tian looked serious and said, "I am discussing Tao with him. The world's martial arts have different paths and lead to the same goal, and medicine is also the Tao. There must be something extraordinary about this fellow Taoist being able to carry so much power of external elixirs in a mortal body. I want to ask him how he practices it."
Arnold also saw him and said contemptuously in broken Chinese: "Little Zha San, Ni, is that Chinese guy who keeps fit naturally??"
Ji Tian nodded, he had questions to ask the other party, but he didn't care about the other party's rudeness.
Arnold patted his chest muscles and said, "Bench press 260 kilograms! Ni, do you want to win the title?"
Ji Tian stretched out a finger.
"One hundred?"
Shake his head.
"A thousand?"
Still shaking his head.
"How much will Ni take?"
Standing with his hands behind his back, Ji Tian put the mineral water on the ground. His eyes were distant, as if he were looking through time and space.
"When I was wandering around in Taixu in my sleep, I once saw an ancestor of Nascent Soul smashing a mountain into pieces with one palm."
Team leader: "..."
Arnold: "..."
"So I feel that using kilograms to measure strength is too small. Strength is about Taoism, state of mind, and understanding of the world. You push two hundred and six, and you push up, but do you 'understand'? Do you feel the mystery of simplicity when the muscle fibers are torn?"
Arnold's face turned green.
The game begins.
Arnold goes first.
His veins bulged out like a python, and his eyes were bloodshot as if he was possessed.
Two hundred and sixty kilograms, done in one go!
The audience burst into applause.
"We're here, little Yakuza!"
Ji Tian walked to the bench press rack. No warm-ups, no yelling, just deep breaths.
Then he closed his eyes.
The people next to him heard him reciting in a deep voice: "...Xuanzong of Heaven and Earth, Wan Qi's root. Cultivate catastrophe extensively and prove my magical powers..."
